content: iza Kanaane biittan diza (Kebroone geetettiza) Qiriyaate-Arba7e katamaan hayqqiin Abrahaamey Saaras yeekkidessinne kayottides.
Abrahaamey ba machchey aha achchafe Hiitetakko biidi,
«Tani intte giddon imaththa; ta machcheyo mooganaas taas intte gadeppe moogoso bayzerketii!» gides.

Hiiteti izas, «Godoo! Nuni nena yootizayssa siya; neni nu giddon gita asa; neni ne machchey aha nu duufoppe nena lo7idaason mooga; neni ne machchey aha mooganaas ba duufo oonikka nena diggenna» gi zaarida.
Abrahaamey dendi eqqidi Hiiteta halaqata sinththan ziggides.

Izi isttas, «Intte tana, ‹Ne machchey aha mooga› giikko siyite; Xoohaare naa Efroones iza gadeza gaxan diza Makipheele geetettiza gongoloza taas duufos bayzana mala kumeththa waagan nuna zal7iserketii» gides.
He wode Efrooney katama pengen shiiqida ba asaa Hiiteta giddon dees; hessa gishshas Hiiteti wuri siyishin Abrahaames,
«Hessa mala gidenna; ta godoo! Ta yootizayssa siya; tani gadezakka iza giddon diza gongolozakka ta nees hayssa asaa sinththan immadis; nekka ne machchey ahaa mooga» gides.
asay siyishin Efroone, «Ta yootizayssa siyarkkii! Tani he gadezas waaga qanxxana; ne taappe ekkarkkii! Heen tani ta machchey aha moogana» gides.

Efrooney Abrahaames zaaridi, «Ta godoo! Tani yootizayssa siya; gadezi 400 saqile bira xalla kessiza gade gidida gishshas hayssi ne giddoninne ta giddon aykkoka gidenna; ne machchey aha izan mooga» gides.
Abrahaamey Hiite asay siyishin Efrooney gida waaga 400 saqile bira Efroones immides.
Mamire katamaa achchan Makipheelen diza Efroone gaden diza gongoloynne he gaden diza miththay wuri,
katamaa pengen shiiqida Hiite asaa ubbaa sinththan wogan Abrahaame gade gidides.
Hessafe guye Abrahaamey ba machcho Saara ahaa Kanaane biittan (Kebroone geetettiza) Mamire katama achchan diza gongolon moogides.
Hessa gishshas he gadezinne gadezan diza gongolozi Hiiteta sinththan wogan Abrahaames gidides.
